name: Burning Rate Emulator

name: Burning and Suppression of Solids
sampleGeometry: Flat and cylindrical samples, 1 to 10 cm long, in a forced-flow duct
objectives: Measure flame spread over solids in low-speed concurrent and opposed flow
Determine flow and nitrogen conditions that extinguish burning solids
keyFindings: Mean flame spread rate increased about 36% between ~24% and ~28% O2 (1.24 to 1.70 mm/s, sustained runs).
Below 5 cm/s, 100% of ignited microgravity runs self-extinguished (oxygen starvation) versus 18% at 5 to 30 cm/s. Above 30 cm/s, 33% blew off.
cotton-fiberglass fabric (SIBAL) spread fastest (1.92 mm/s mean) and PMMA slowest (0.68 mm/s), a 2.8x difference across 3 materials.
With 15% or more nitrogen dilution, 92% of runs failed to ignite or were quenched, versus 43% undiluted.

iss.rationale: ISS: tested range brackets 21% O2 at 14.7 psi; solid materials match cabin fabrics, plastics and wiring; microgravity matches.
